descriptionChirho: Sexual immorality or lewdness, especially in contexts of illicit sexual conduct and moral depravity, consistently rendered with specifically sexual vocabulary across languages (Arabic فَاحِشَة, Swahili uasherati, Spanish perversidad/depravación, Korean 음란).
General wickedness or evil purpose, not specifically sexual in nature, rendered with vocabulary denoting moral evil or vileness (Arabic رَذِيلَة/شَرّ, Swahili uovu, Spanish maldad, Korean 악/사악한).

A deliberate plan, scheme, or purpose, whether evil or neutral, consistently translated with planning/scheming vocabulary across languages (Arabic فِكْرَة/مَقَاصِد/مَكِيدَات, Swahili mpango/hila, Spanish plan/maquinaciones, Korean 계획/음모).
